about: The write2DPES cuts of this case (gate 1c, docs/validation.md): each object's keys are added to input.json (the C++) and DVR.inp (the Fortran, tools/fortran_reference/run_pes_cut_reference.sh); cut k (from 1) gives pes_cut_<k>.dat. A key left out keeps the Fortran default (x2DPES 0, y2DPES 0, theta2DPES 90, phi2DPES 0).
